title: slide-nextup design choice
description: decks/<id>/design.json: the visual direction the user chose for one deck. Written by design:set; deck:scaffold takes its default theme from it and deck:validate reports a deck that sits on another theme.

theme.description: the id of the chosen theme pack, resolved from the deck folder outwards (deck folder, workspace, user directory, package)

direction.description: the name of the direction the user picked (safe, bold, free, or the pitch's own label); optional

chosenAt.description: when the choice was recorded, ISO 8601; optional
